findings.title: _source without _id is returned with encrypted attributes intact
findings.body: When the response has a `_source` column but no `_id` column (e.g. `metadata: ['_source']`, or `| DROP _id`), decryption is skipped and the row is returned unchanged. `stripEncryptedColumns` does not touch `_source` either, so encrypted ciphertext leaks. In that case, strip the encrypted attributes from `_source` instead of returning it as is.

findings.title: Encrypted-column stripping relies on exact column names and can be bypassed
findings.body: Values are only nulled when a column is named exactly `<type>.<encryptedAttr>`. The caller controls the pipeline, so `| EVAL x = connector.secrets`, `| RENAME connector.secrets AS s`, or a `STATS`/`CONCAT` over the field returns the raw ciphertext under another name. Filter the encrypted fields out on the ES side before the user pipeline runs, for example with a `DROP` right after FROM, instead of post-processing column names.

findings.title: Agent planning artifacts committed to the repository.
findings.body: `tasks/prd.json` and `tasks/progress.txt` are working files from the agent loop: a PRD checklist and a progress log. They are not product code, will go stale, and add noise to the Kibana repo root. Remove both files from the PR, or add them to `.gitignore`.
